label: Q10 temperature scaling: the ratio between two temperatures is Q10 raised to their difference over ten
statement_en: For a rate X(T) = X0 Q10^((T - Tref)/10) with X0 nonzero and Q10 > 0, the ratio X(T2)/X(T1) is Q10^((T2 - T1)/10), and the log of that ratio is (T2 - T1)/10 times log Q10, so a Q10 fit is a straight line in log rate against temperature.
